channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Irish Guide Dogs to Lead Cork St. Patrick's Day Parade as Grand Marshal
item.description: Irish Guide Dogs named Grand Marshal of Cork's St. Patrick's Day Parade as the charity marks 50 years of changing lives. Parade takes place 17 March at 1pm.

item.title: Animal on N40 South Ring Road
item.description: Reports of an animal (Lurcher dog) on the N40 South Ring Road in the Togher/Wilton area. The animal is running into oncoming traffic, posing a serious risk. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on N20 Kilmona/Blarney
item.description: Reports of a collision, southbound, on the N20 Mallow - Cork Road between Kilmona and Blarney Business Park. Take care on approach.

item.title: Government Launches Public Consultation on Ireland's EV Charging Future
item.description: Government opens consultation on national EV charging strategy as Ireland passes 212,000 registered electric vehicles on the road.

item.title: Finalists Announced for 69th Cork Business of the Year Awards as Public Voting Opens
item.description: Finalists announced for the 69th Cork Business of the Year Awards, with public voting now open.

item.title: Lidl Gets Green Light for €200 Million Distribution Centre at Little Island
item.description: Lidl Ireland secures planning approval for a €200m distribution centre at Little Island, Cork, backing 22 local stores and reinforcing its major investment in the Munster economy.

item.title: Vehicle in Water Horgans Quay
item.description: Reports a vehicle has entered the water near Horgan’s Quay. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Missing Person Appeal: Gardaí Seek Public's Help to Find Krystyna Adamczyk (59) Missing from Mallow
item.description: Gardaí seeking public's help to locate Krystyna Adamczyk (59), missing from Mallow, Co. Cork since yesterday afternoon.

item.title: Roadworks on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of roadworks, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 10 Mahon and Junction 6 (N27) Kinsale Road (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 26 February at 21:00.

item.title: Road Closure on N25 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a road closure due to roadworks, westbound, on the N25 between Junction 2 Little Island and Junction 1 (M8/N40) Dunkettle (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 26 February at 21:00.
